title: The Coinsurance Applied to a Restated Ridgecrest Advantage Claim Line
content:
**Where is the coinsurance for a restated line found?** In the cost-share figures of the Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan held, and which of those figures is taken follows the network standing of the line the correction restates and the benefit category it carries.

**An out-of-network line whose benefit category is not one the plan always covers at the in-network cost share.** The share of the amount after the deductible the member meets is the coinsurance the plan held fixes for covered out-of-network care.

**An out-of-network line whose benefit category is one the plan always covers at the in-network cost share.** That share is the coinsurance the plan held fixes for outpatient dialysis, that being the only such benefit category the plan held prices by a coinsurance.

**An in-network line.** That share is the coinsurance the plan held fixes for in-network outpatient surgery.

**What tells the second entry from the first?** The benefit category alone. Both are out-of-network lines; the one the plan always covers at the in-network cost share takes the outpatient dialysis coinsurance of the plan held, and every other out-of-network line takes the coinsurance the plan held fixes for covered out-of-network care.

*Hypothetical case: an amount after the deductible of 600.00 USD on a plan whose coinsurance for covered out-of-network care is 35 per cent, for outpatient dialysis 20 per cent and for in-network outpatient surgery 25 per cent.* An out-of-network line of an ordinary benefit category gives 210.00 USD; an out-of-network dialysis line gives 120.00 USD; and an in-network line gives 150.00 USD.
